messages:
Maria: Quick note — my docs PR for the SDK examples (GH #742) is waiting on review but Netlify preview keeps taking forever (22m then times out). Can reviewers still check the diffs or should we hold for the merge slot?

Jon: I can review, but the preview assets are missing in the Netlify build. CI shows upload retries. Not great for judging visual changes.

deploy-bot: Netlify build #742-preview started at 2026-03-21 13:05 UTC — status: running.

Maria: Copy. @Jon if you can eyeball markdown/code snippets that's fine, but a couple of changes depend on the previewed rendered tables and anchors.

Jon: Pasting the tail of the build log I saw: 
```
Error: EMFILE: too many open files, write /tmp/netlify/artifacts/asset-blob-17
Retrying upload (4/5)...
Upload failed: 504 Gateway Timeout
```
Seems like an agent concurrency bug when packaging static assets.

Docs-CI: Re-run requested by @Maria. Attempting rebuild...

Sam: We saw EMFILE before — workaround is to build locally with mkdocs and push the small rendered snapshot as a comment for reviewers. Steps:
1) pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
2) mkdocs serve -a 127.0.0.1:8000
3) open http://127.0.0.1:8000 and validate anchors and examples
If you want to create a quick tarball of the site: `mkdocs build -d site_snapshot && tar -czf snapshot.tgz site_snapshot` and attach to the PR.

Maria: Nice — I'll add a snapshot to the PR. Any objections to merging to main during the 2pm merge window if reviewers approve, even if Netlify preview still fails?

Lee: @Maria I'd prefer waiting if the change touches TOC and cross-page anchors — we've had regressions before. But if Jon + Sam sign off and you attach the snapshot, I'm OK with merging in the scheduled slot.

Jon: I reviewed the markdown and code snippets. Two tiny nits I pushed as separate commits — no rendering dependencies.

Maria: Thanks. I added the snapshot.tgz and a short checklist in the PR description with local preview commands and the specific anchor ids to sanity-check.

Docs-CI: Build #742-preview re-run completed — status: failed. Error bucket: artifact-uploader/EMFILE. Investigating.

Sam: For reviewers: when Netlify is flaky, please: 1) review diffs + code blocks inline, 2) download snapshot if present, 3) leave an explicit :eyes: comment if you can't run the site locally. That helps SRE prioritize the Netlify queue.

Maria: @Lee @Jon can you both leave a clear approval (or request-changes) by 13:50 UTC so I can merge during the 14:00 slot if Netlify still hasn't produced a preview?

Lee: Will do.

Jon: Approved — left :+1: and a brief comment.

Maria: Merging in the 14:00 slot unless any last-minute flags. If Netlify flakiness persists, I'll open a follow-up ticket with build logs and the snapshot. Thanks all :rocket:

deploy-bot: Merge scheduled by @Maria for 14:00 UTC.

Docs-CI: Note: consider reducing concurrent file handles in the packager (NODE_MAX_OPEN_FILES env) or switch to streaming uploads; tagging eng-infra.

Maria: Filed infra ticket: ENGINFRA-1129 with logs and snapshot attached.

Sam: Thanks — linking the ticket in the PR now.

Lee: Thanks everyone — good pattern for future PRs when previews are unreliable.
